Both cannot hold at once, so I satisfied rule 2 (and the loader's stated behavior of reading the checksum at position 0), which necessarily moves `id` from position 0 to position 1. This appears to be the only interpretation the loader can actually work with, and it matches the published 2026-08-22 changelog entry that introduced the checksum column. You may want to fix rule 1 in `IMPORT_RULES.md` so it reflects that `id` stays second.
